name: Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai
contribution: A Sindhi Sufi and poet who is widely considered to be the greatest poet in the Sindhi language.

checks.lead: Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai (c. 1689 or 1690 – 21 December 1752, also known as Lakhino Latif, Latif Ghot, Bhittai, and Bhit Jo Shah) was a Sindhi Sufi and poet who is widely considered to be the greatest poet in the Sindhi language.
